head: 712cbdb
note: Law-1 parking lot. Nothing here was dropped; each item states why it is parked rather than filed.

items.title: PhlimboEA V1 reports totalStaked() == 13,615.682e18 against a phUSD balance of ZERO
items.disposition: parked — root cause outside the promotion-ready closure, not filed as a finding here
items.observation: PhlimboEA V1 (0x3984eBC8…19F4) reports `totalStaked() == 13,615.682e18` while holding a phUSD balance of ZERO. V1 is paused, its ETH balance is 0, and its stake token is phUSD (0xf3B5…D605).
items.assessment: The figure is accounting residue that the V1->V2 migration never cleared. It is NOT stranded user value — nothing is owed to V1 stakers. The contract holds no phUSD because the phUSD moved with the migration; only the counter was left behind.
items.whyParked: Root cause lives in lib/phlimbo-ea V1's migration path, OUTSIDE the promotion-ready entry-point closure this run audited. Expanding the audit to reach it would exceed the closure; the correct next step is a separate /analyze of phlimbo-ea V1's migration path.
whyItMattersHere: (i) It is the empirical answer to the standing question 'why does V1 appear to hold more than V2?'

(ii) It is why the currently-routed deposit view is worse than merely stale: it serves believable non-zero numbers backed by an empty contract, which is exactly what makes L-01's window hazardous rather than obviously-broken.
items.recommendation: Run a separate /analyze of phlimbo-ea V1's migration path; do not expand this audit.
